# `orders`
Columns: id, customer, ordered_at, store_id, subtotal, tax_paid, order_total, order_weekday, order_hour
Measures: total_revenue, net_sales, tax_collected, order_count, unique_customers, avg_order_value, effective_tax_rate, sales_weighted_aov
Aggregations: dollars, weighted_avg
Joins to: customers, stores

Column: demo_database.orders.order_weekday
Type: INT
Description: ISO day of week the order was placed: 1 = Monday … 7 = Sunday. Use with order_hour for day-part and staffing analysis.
Label: Order weekday
Allowed aggregations: count, count_distinct, min, max
SQL: CAST(EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM ordered_at) AS INT)
Sample values: 1 .. 7

Column: demo_database.orders.order_hour
Type: INT
Description: Hour of day the order was placed (0–23, store local time as stored in ordered_at). Use with order_weekday for peak-hour heatmaps.
Label: Order hour
Allowed aggregations: count, count_distinct, min, max
SQL: CAST(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM ordered_at) AS INT)
Sample values: 7 .. 19
